notes: Web Package 899 / sos-cache-v899. Realtime performance: P2P transfer flow control, voice P2P E2EE, call relay health failover and ring latency. Secure incoming-call receiver starts on identity readiness (no outgoing-call priming). Security closure: mesh relay signals are recipient-bound P2pSecureV2 ciphertext only; outgoing call signaling is kind 1059 only (no 25050 downgrade on policy failure). First-group network-backed administration (israel-network). Group control panel behind a 6-digit admin PIN lock with server-side Admin 2FA (server PIN verifier + attestation signer; enforcement ships OFF until owner enrollment). User-centric group control UX (search, per-user role and permissions; saving disabled until the control plane is activated). Admin 2FA enforcement ON with the pinned production signer; root-only Gate 1.5 activation (attested genesis, no grants). Gate 2: owner-activated admission service delegation (single FINALIZE_MEMBERSHIP_ADMISSION capability, Admin 2FA attested). Gate 4: accessControlV2Scope (FULL | CONTROL_PLANE); CONTROL_PLANE keeps member content, P2P and the single-network UI as V2 off. ACCESS_CONTROL_V2 ships OFF. 899h: top-bar invite reconciles authority before the capability check (INVITE_USERS propagation); Worker-identity recovery via sealed F5B6-W handoff to the isolated signer and F5B5 reveal; truthful onboarding (no fake key field/buttons); logout/switch guarded until the recovery backup is confirmed. 899i: account creation includes the personal key — after Passkey the isolated signer saves SOS-personal-key-<fingerprint>.txt locally and returns only a non-secret completion (PERSONAL_KEY_EXPORTED); login accepts the key file. 899j: profile metadata is actually published (awaited typed signature, relay acks, monotonic created_at), avatar/cover stored as durable Blossom https URLs, profile page loads the signer; one newest-wins profile resolution for feed, conversations, public profile and group management (stub names are refreshed); the floating home group-management button is removed (menu entry only). 899k: per-user permission panel shows three primary permissions (הזמנת חברים, מחיקת פוסטים ותגובות, ניהול חברים) with short explanations; the other canonical capabilities are in a collapsed advanced section (UI only, protocol unchanged). 899l: MANAGE_MEMBERS description matches its effect (remove members and manage their membership state, no permission changes); pending joins are read-only with an automatic-approval status (no dead manual approve button; admission stays with the Admission Service). 899m: Phase 1 moderation and member control - four primary permissions (INVITE_USERS, MODERATE_CONTENT, MANAGE_MEMBERS, MANAGE_BLOCKLIST); per-user remove / block / unblock / user content (canonical blocklist + membership, Admin 2FA); blocked authors' posts, comments and videos are hidden in SOS by pubkey suppression from the verified blocklist (no relay deletion claimed); blocked members cannot post, comment, react, invite, use group control or P2P; report button on posts, videos and comments with private sealed per-moderator reports (kind 39010 wrap, no public report), moderator reports tab with statuses and badge; audit rows for content removal, block/unblock and report resolution. Multi-community network deferred. MD4 not started. Android/APK frozen. 899n: existing users are added directly from group control through the canonical GRANT_ACTIVE membership transition (ROOT or MANAGE_MEMBERS, Admin 2FA, relay readback; no invite, no capabilities granted); invites are for new users only - 24h maximum lifetime, single use, active list plus collapsed history with ACTIVE / USED / EXPIRED / REVOKED statuses; no join-approval UI. 899o: israel-network default membership — SOS-registered accounts (own email-registry 37377) are members unless REMOVED/BLOCKED; owner-authorized reviewed reconciliation via canonical GRANT_ACTIVE (no capabilities); no add-to-group button for normal users in the default community; Admin 2FA control attestations pushed to the admission service. 899p: group control "כל המשתמשים" directory - every known SOS identity (members, legacy SOS accounts with their own registry record or SOS profile, removed, blocked) with avatar, name, short id, status and last activity; filters and search; per-user drawer. A reviewed legacy account can be confirmed as a plain member, or saving "ניהול הרשאות" completes canonical membership first and then applies exactly the chosen permissions (Admin 2FA; removed / blocked never re-added; arbitrary Nostr keys rejected; no automatic capability or invite authority). Temporary membership-gap panel removed from the UI. 899q: moderator deletion of other users' posts and comments uses the same canonical path as ROOT (signed target, Admin 2FA attestation, relay ack and readback before success; failure restores the item and shows an error); the video feed subscribes to group moderation (39002) and its attestations (39004) so removals reach every client live and after refresh; invite menu shown only with INVITE_USERS or ROOT and updated live; group control menu only for ROOT or management capabilities (moderators get a reports-only entry, direct open denied); user directory avatars use the shared newest-profile resolver with an initials fallback. Durable moderation: a finalized removal is replayed on its Admin 2FA attestation (issued only after the creation-time authority check), so revoking a moderator stops new removals without undoing old ones; historical moderation is fetched per visible target (#d, then the bound attestations by #e), not from the newest N events. 899r: the video feed renders without waiting for likes/comments/shares; engagement hydrates in the background with bounded relay queries, so a slow or dead relay can no longer leave the fresh guest or signed-in feed black.
